## **Preis und Paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Preis und Paywall.**
      1 aktuelle Review(s) erwähnen preis und paywall.
      Review-Fenster: 04.08.2026 - 04.08.2026
      **Warum das zählt:** Nutzer erwähnen Preis, Abos oder Paywalls. Das kann Preissensibilität in der Nische signalisieren.

         **Review-Beispiele:**
            1. _Fadi Mujahid_, 04.08.2026, 3/5: "The app is very good at what it does and I purchased the premium app. However, the app keeps Google Play Service up all the time which results in battery drainage, which is very frustrating. Unlike other apps which might use Google services to check on the purchase, this app checks with this service on each click. Very unprofessional"
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Bugs und Stabilität** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs und Stabilität.**
      1 aktuelle Review(s) erwähnen bugs und stabilität.
      Review-Fenster: 18.09.2026 - 18.09.2026
      **Warum das zählt:** Nutzer erwähnen Crashes oder Instabilität. Nur bei Volume-Spike oder nach einem Update als actionable werten; sonst oft Baseline-Rauschen.

         **Review-Beispiele:**
            1. _Mohsen_, 18.09.2026, 5/5: "I used this app for almost 2 years, it has always been great. I don't remember if I ever encountered a bug or problem. The only reason I had to switch to a different app was that HabitNow does not provide an easy way to sync between devices. I remember I had to spend long durations to think about writing/managing tasks and habits and I'd rather do long tasks with a laptop with a proper desk and posture. Spending long durations on HabitNow on my phone always led to bad posture and neck pain."
<!--/ir-theme-->
